channels.name: RF antenna (sub-GHz)
channels.purpose: CSS-modulated LoRa uplink/downlink in the regional band.
channels.idle_level: radio off (Class A/B) or RX-listening (Class C)

channels.name: Transceiver SPI (SCK/MOSI/MISO/NSS)
channels.purpose: Configure the LoRa modem and move payloads.

channels.name: DIO interrupts (TxDone/RxDone/RxTimeout/CAD)
channels.purpose: Signal transmit/receive completion and channel-activity detection.

global_signals.name: Beacon (Class B)
global_signals.purpose: Periodic gateway beacon for ping-slot synchronization.

handshake_pairs.name: Uplink/RX
handshake_pairs.rule: Uplink then RX1/RX2 windows for any downlink.

handshake_pairs.name: ADR
handshake_pairs.rule: LinkADRReq -> LinkADRAns to set DR/TX-power/channel mask.

handshake_pairs.name: MAC command
handshake_pairs.rule: Req/Ans carried in FOpts or on FPort 0.

dependency_graph.common_rule: An end-device must be activated (OTAA join or ABP) before sending data; every uplink (Class A) is followed by RX1 then RX2; the network server deduplicates multi-gateway receptions.
dependency_graph.data_dependency: A data frame requires a valid session context (DevAddr/NwkSKey/AppSKey); the MIC is computed over the frame with FCnt and NwkSKey; FRMPayload is encrypted with AppSKey.

logical_signaling_levels.name: Uplink
logical_signaling_levels.meaning: End-device -> gateway(s) CSS frame (preamble + sync + header + payload + CRC).

logical_signaling_levels.name: Downlink
logical_signaling_levels.meaning: Gateway -> end-device CSS frame in an RX window / ping slot / continuous receive.

ordering_rules.frame_order: Frames are ordered by the frame counter (FCnt); non-increasing counters are rejected as replays.
ordering_rules.rx_priority: RX1 is checked before RX2; a valid RX1 downlink suppresses RX2.
